task_name: Verranza Coastal Retreats - Villa collection image system
client_brief:
Three villas, one collection: imagery, crops and the gate monogram

For Verranza Coastal Retreats, the challenge is consistency without making three different villas interchangeable. We need the stone, limewash and coastal light to sit comfortably together across direct bookings and agent materials. The supplied do-not-want references are important.

Please prepare
- Villa booking hero: 3 named exports. The named villa matches the photograph. The offer price agrees with the approved rate record. The booking action is readable.
- Villa comparison brochure: 1 named export. Villa identities are unambiguous. The comparison makes differences between the properties easy to scan. Rates preserve their stated season.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Luxury vacation rental collection of three villas above a cove, letting direct and to a small travel-agent trade channel, hospitality and travel.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Liguria, Italy; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Verranza Coastal Retreats is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Liguria, Italy, and this commission covers phase 1: villa image system and booking imagery.
brand_identity.audience: Guests aged 35 to 60, American and Northern European families and groups of friends booking a whole house for a week, plus a small trade channel of travel agents working from printed rate cards. They pay for a real place and refuse anything that looks staged or cooked.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Upper-mid coastal rental, 520 to 780 euros a night in season. A restraint band, not a gloss band: honest light and true water rather than saturated marketplace glow, and firmly above budget literalism.
brand_identity.typography: Verranza Coastal Retreats runs the booking heroes in four steps. Step 01 is the house name in Canela Deck Light at 72 px on 78 px with tracking of minus 10 units, and its first letter is drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, roughly 144 px, so Casa Oliveto opens on one tall C. Step 02 is the standfirst, also Canela Deck Light, at 26 px on 30 px with tracking of minus 4 units, with Light the heaviest weight the serif may take. Step 03 is body and the booking line in Untitled Sans Regular at 20 px on 30 px, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters. Step 04 is rates and captions in Untitled Sans Regular at 15 px on 22 px with tracking of plus 8 units and tabular lining figures. In the brochure the name is 34 pt, body 10 pt on 15 pt and rates 9 pt. No numeral is ever set in the serif, and there is no gold.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, plain and place-first. We name the stone, the water and the afternoon light, and we never oversell. Example line: 'Three houses above the cove, let by the family who has kept them.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The collection has never had a logo file. The monogram exists only as the wrought-iron plate the village smith cut when the first house was bought, and all we hold is a photograph of it on the gate. The travel-agent rate cards survive only as the file the printer sent to press last year, with no working source.
brand_identity.values: Honest representation of a real place, true water and true stone, and a family mark used quietly.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: Each house name opens with an oversized Canela Deck Light initial at twice the cap height of the rest of the word, and no numeral is ever set in the serif.

scale.note: House name. The first letter is drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, about 144 px against a 72 px name, so Casa Oliveto opens on one tall C. Brochure equivalent 34 pt.

scale.sample: Three houses above the cove, kept by the family.
scale.note: Standfirst. Light is the heaviest weight the serif is allowed.

scale.sample: Book the whole house for a week, direct with the family.
scale.note: Max 65 characters. Also carries the booking line at this size. Brochure body 10 pt on 15 pt.

scale.sample: 520 to 780 euros a night in season
scale.note: Rates and captions, tabular lining figures. Brochure rates 9 pt. No numeral is ever set in the serif.

type_system.signature_move: Each house name opens with an oversized Canela Deck Light initial drawn to twice the cap height of the rest of the word, and every numeral stays in Untitled Sans tabular lining figures, never in the serif.
rules: No numeral is ever set in the serif. Every figure lives in Untitled Sans, tabular lining.
No weight above Light in Canela Deck.
The oversized initial is always the first letter of the house name, at twice the cap height of the rest of that word.
Rates and captions are Untitled Sans Regular only.
Name the stone, the water and the light, and never oversell.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
